gloss: absence without notice; unauthorized absence from work

definitions.gloss: absence without notice; unauthorized absence from work
definitions.explanation: Being absent from work without informing one's employer or obtaining permission beforehand. A serious workplace infraction in Japan.

examples.japanese: {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Unauthorized absence from work is not tolerated.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{三日間|みっかかん}{無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}した。
examples.english: He was absent from work for three days without notice.

examples.japanese: {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}が{続|つづ}くと、{解雇|かいこ}の{理由|りゆう}になることがある。
examples.english: Continued unauthorized absences can become grounds for dismissal.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound of {無断|むだん} (without permission) + {欠勤|けっきん} (absence from work). Used as a suru verb ({無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}する). This is considered a serious infraction in Japanese workplaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}する (to be absent without notice)
- {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}が{続|つづ}く (unauthorized absences continue)
- {無断欠勤|むだんけっきん}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す (to repeatedly be absent without notice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {欠勤|けっきん}: absence from work — the general term, not necessarily unauthorized
- {無断|むだん}{欠席|けっせき}: unauthorized absence — used for school or meetings rather than work
